nepal.title: File:View of Kathmandu Valley.jpg
nepal.author: Anshu kipa priya shrestha
nepal.desc: View of Kathmandu Valley captured en route to Druk Amitabha Mountain Monastery, locally known as the White Gumba (Seto Gumba). This uphill road to the Monastery begins from Nagarjun Municipality located in the western outskirts of Kathmandu city.

nepal.title: File:Sansad Bhavan of Nepal (International Convention Centre Nepal)-070A4427.jpg
nepal.author: Bijay Chaurasia
nepal.desc: The Sansad Bhawan in Nepal refers to the Federal Parliament building, which houses both the House of Representatives (Pratinidhi Sabha) and the National Assembly (Rastriya Sabha). It is the supreme legislature of Nepal and was established in 2018.
